patterns.note: Uses full-bleed sections with alternating dark and light background colors to delineate content blocks, often featuring a subtle grid pattern or gradient overlay.
A high-contrast palette combining a deep, dark teal/blue with a vibrant, almost neon green accent, creating a modern and high-tech feel.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, while body text is clear and readable. Code examples are set in a distinct monospace font.

The top informational banner disappears on scroll, and the main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top. Content scrolls over a fixed, subtly animated background grid and a glowing hero illustration.
Features a 'Loved by builders' section showcasing client logos and a testimonial, emphasizing trust and adoption within the developer community.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that activates after a short scroll, causing a top informational banner to slide out of view. The hero section features a fixed background with a subtle, animated grid pattern (likely canvas or CSS keyframes) over which the main content scrolls, creating a layered depth effect. Subsequent content sections appear to load statically as the user scrolls, without explicit scroll-triggered fade-ins or slides for entire sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by clear, readable body text and distinct monospace for code snippets.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — a slight rounding on buttons, cards, and input fields, avoiding sharp corners but not fully pill-shaped.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — airy in the hero section with ample negative space, transitioning to a more balanced density in feature grids and a denser footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, grid-patterned background combined with a vibrant, glowing green accent and integrated UI elements in the hero creates a strong, high-tech, and data-driven aesthetic. This visual language effectively communicates innovation and power, setting it apart from more generic corporate designs.
